description: This file defines functions and types for handling approval requests via native channel plans, including delivery logic, runtime creation, and handling approval targets and content.

methods.name: buildTargetKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key string for a given ChannelApprovalNativeTarget based on its 'to' and 'threadId' properties.

methods.name: deliverApprovalRequestViaChannelNativePlan
methods.description: Main function to deliver approval requests through a native channel plan, handling delivery, deduplication, and callbacks.

methods.name: defaultResolveApprovalKind
methods.description: Determines the approval kind ('plugin' or 'exec') based on the request's id prefix.

methods.name: createChannelNativeApprovalRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for handling approval channels with customizable adapters and content building.
